name: CWE code safety
description: Matched normal (A) and vulnerable (B) C programs.

pairs.title: Improper Authentication
pairs.summary: Authentication logic mistakenly treats a nonzero strcmp() result as success.

pairs.title: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input
pairs.summary: Unbounded %s input can copy more data than the destination buffer can hold.

pairs.title: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
pairs.summary: An unchecked copy can overwrite memory beyond a fixed-size stack buffer.

pairs.title: Heap-based Buffer Overflow
pairs.summary: A fixed-size heap allocation is followed by an unbounded copy.

pairs.title: Out-of-bounds Read
pairs.summary: The index is used without checking whether it is inside the array bounds.

pairs.title: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String
pairs.summary: User-controlled text is interpreted as a printf format string.

pairs.title: Improper Null Termination
pairs.summary: strncpy() may fill the destination without appending a null terminator.

pairs.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
pairs.summary: Unsigned arithmetic is performed without checking whether the result wraps.

pairs.title: Integer Underflow or Wraparound
pairs.summary: Subtracting a larger unsigned value from a smaller one can wrap to a huge value.

pairs.title: Off-by-one Error
pairs.summary: The <= condition writes one byte past the end of the array.

pairs.title: Unchecked Return Value
pairs.summary: The code uses fopen() results without checking whether the call succeeded.

pairs.title: Divide By Zero
pairs.summary: Invalid input can make the divisor zero.

pairs.title: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime
pairs.summary: Allocated memory is not released after it is no longer needed.

pairs.title: Double Free
pairs.summary: The same heap allocation is released twice.

pairs.title: Use After Free
pairs.summary: The program accesses heap memory after that allocation has been freed.

pairs.title: Use of Uninitialized Variable
pairs.summary: A security decision depends on a variable that is not initialized on every path.

pairs.title: Use of sizeof() on a Pointer Type
pairs.summary: sizeof(buf) returns the size of the pointer, not the allocated object.

pairs.title: NULL Pointer Dereference
pairs.summary: strchr() can return NULL, which is dereferenced without validation.

pairs.title: Memory Allocation with Excessive Size Value
pairs.summary: Untrusted input directly controls an allocation size without an upper bound.

pairs.title: Out-of-bounds Write
pairs.summary: An unchecked index controls where a write occurs relative to a fixed-size array.
